data.text: א  Aleph Praise Yah! How blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, ב  Beth Who greatly delights in His commandments.
ג  Gimel His seed will be mighty on earth; ד  Daleth The generation of the upright will be blessed.
ה  He Wealth and riches are in his house, ו  Vav And his righteousness stands forever.
ז  Zayin Light arises in the darkness for the upright; ח  Heth He is gracious and compassionate and righteous.
ט  Teth It is well with the man who is gracious and lends; י  Yodh Who sustains his works with justice.
כ  Kaph For he will never be shaken; ל  Lamedh The righteous will be remembered forever.
מ  Mem He will not fear an evil report; נ  Nun His heart is set, trusting in Yahweh.
ס  Samekh His heart is upheld, he will not fear, ע  Ayin Until he looks in triumph on his adversaries.
פ  Pe He has given freely to the needy, צ  Tsadhe His righteousness stands forever; ק  Qoph His horn will be raised in glory.
ר  Resh The wicked will see it and be vexed, שׁ  Shin He will gnash his teeth and melt away; ת  Tav The desire of the wicked will perish.
